mechanism: Dorzolamide can cause systemic absorption leading to carbonic anhydrase inhibition and metabolic effects; guanfacine is an alpha-2 agonist that may have additive hypotensive effects when combined with dorzolamide's potential systemic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; assess for excessive hypotension or CNS effects; guanfacine dose adjustment may be necessary if hypotension develops.
